card.name: Cross-reference words like see and below
card.fires_on: Cross-reference words in drug labels that point the reader elsewhere, such as "see", "refer" or "below", just before a table, section name or list.

modes.label: See / Refer before a section or table
modes.description: The word "see" or "refer" opens a pointer to a table or labeled section, often in parentheses.
modes.example: DOPTELET SPRINKLE dose adjustments (<<see>> Table 5 and Table 6 )

modes.label: Listed below
modes.description: The word "below" follows "listed" or "diluents listed" and points to a list that follows.
modes.example: may be mixed with diluents listed<< below>>. Diluents 0.9

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where the text sends you to another table or section.
